# `jouet wait pr`

- **Usage:** `jouet wait pr [--repo <OWNER/NAME>] <--until <CONDITION>> [PR]`

Wait for a PR to become mergeable, merged, approved, ready, ...

--until is one of: mergeable (keeps waiting while GitHub reports UNKNOWN; exit 1 on a conflict), merged (exit 1 if closed unmerged), closed, approved (exit 1 when changes are requested), checks-registered (any check on the head), ready (no `pr status` attention codes and no pending checks; exit 1 on conflict, checks_failing, changes_requested or unresolved_threads), or any-change (the next push, check result, review, thread or state change, printed as one event). A conflict counts once GitHub reports it again 10s later, since right after a push it can still answer for the old head.

## Arguments
- **`[PR]`** — The PR: a number, URL, OWNER/REPO#N or branch. Defaults to the current branch's PR

## Flags
- **`--repo <OWNER/NAME>`** — The repository for a bare number or branch. Defaults to the git remote
- **`--until <CONDITION>`** — The condition to wait for
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
